title: Uranium at Skinwalker Ranch
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Uranium at Skinwalker Ranch, about modern at Skinwalker Ranch, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a modern context on Skinwalker Ranch, they say that there's like a lot of uranium around.

plain: Skinwalker Ranch is a property in Utah known for reports of strange lights, creatures and other odd events. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that people who look at the ranch today claim there is a lot of uranium, a radioactive metal, in the ground around it. He raises it as a possible link between the land itself and the strange things said to happen there.
